items.title: Marilyn Crispell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 21, 2022
items.q: She has collaborated with Anthony Braxton, Henry Grimes, and Reggie Workman

ctx.x: Marilyn Crispell is a pianist and composer who explores the boundaries of improvised music. She has collaborated with Anthony Braxton, Henry Grimes, and Reggie Workman, and has produced numerous recordings with her own trio. She received an Outstanding Alumni Award from the New England Conservatory of Music.
Marilyn was interviewed via Zoom on January 21, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
